source_resolution_history.description: One retrieval route for the Surace–Tagliacozzo paper returned HTML (3817 bytes). A full-text search immediately recovered the same paper as the arXiv PDF; the source was retained and used, not dropped. Its failed route, search, successful recovery time, and per-item source dispositions are recorded above. Because the source recovered, no dropped-source alternative-proof record or owner escalation applies.
